title: Staying past the lock costs more than leaving during it
rootCause: Lock.calcPenaltyAmount takes the penalty from the time left in the current cycle, so a staker who stayed for the whole lock and exits a day into the next cycle pays more than one who left two thirds of the way through.

poc.observable: test_staying_longer_does_not_cost_a_larger_penalty fails with "the penalty after 31 days, against the one after 20: 48833000000000000000 > 26666000000000000000"
